entry.title: TacGNN 论文精读：只有触觉，机器人如何完成手内操作？
entry.content:
问题：视觉被拿掉之后，操作还剩下什么？

手内操作要求机器人持续改变物体在手中的姿态。视觉方案通常依赖相机和遮挡较少的场景，但在拥挤、遮挡或接触密集的环境里，视觉信息会迅速变得不可靠。

TacGNN 关注的核心问题是：如果只保留触觉反馈，机器人能否仍然学习到有效的操作策略，并把局部接触信息组织成对整体状态的理解？

The problem: what remains when vision is removed?

In-hand manipulation requires a robot to continuously change an object’s pose within its hand. Vision-based systems usually depend on cameras and relatively clear sight lines. In cluttered, occluded or contact-rich settings, that information becomes unreliable.

TacGNN focuses on a harder question: can tactile feedback alone support useful manipulation policies, and can local contact signals be organised into a representation of the whole object?

方法：把接触关系组织成层级图

这项工作的关键不是“把触觉塞进一个更大的网络”，而是选择一种适合接触数据的结构。连续时刻的触觉读数首先形成局部节点，节点之间再通过空间和时间关系建立连接，最终得到可以传递、聚合和更新的层级图表示。

这种方法的价值在于同时保留两类信息：

  • 局部细节：某个接触点何时出现、压力如何变化。
  • 全局关系：不同接触点如何共同解释物体的运动状态。

动作策略因此不必只依赖最近一帧，而可以从一段接触历史中推断下一步。

Method: turning contact into a hierarchy of graphs

The important idea is not simply adding a larger network. It is choosing a structure that matches contact data. Tactile readings across time become local nodes, then spatial and temporal relations connect those nodes into a hierarchical graph that can pass, aggregate and update information.

This preserves two levels at once:

  • Local detail: when a contact appears and how pressure changes.
  • Global relation: how multiple contacts together explain the object’s motion.

The policy can therefore reason over a short history of contact instead of relying on a single latest frame.

读这篇论文时，我会重点检查什么？

  1. 触觉输入是否真的足够：论文是否说明了传感器布局、采样频率和缺失数据处理方式。
  2. 图结构是否有必要：简单的时序模型或 MLP 基线能否达到接近效果，层级关系带来了什么增益。
  3. 真机证据是否充分：是否包含不同物体、初始姿态和接触条件下的重复实验，而不只是顺畅演示。
  4. 失败边界是否清楚：哪些物体最容易掉落，策略在接触噪声、滑移或传感器故障下表现如何。

What I check when reading the paper

  1. Is tactile input sufficient: sensor layout, sampling rate and missing-data handling should be explicit.
  2. Is the graph necessary: can a simpler temporal model or MLP baseline get close, and what does the hierarchy add?
  3. Is the real-robot evidence strong: repeated trials across objects, initial poses and contact conditions matter more than a smooth demonstration.
  4. Are failure boundaries clear: which objects fall most often, and how does the policy behave under contact noise, slip or sensor failure?

TacGNN 最值得带走的地方，不是某一次操作成功率，而是它把“接触”重新组织成了一种可以推理的结构。

The most transferable idea in TacGNN is not a single success rate. It is the decision to organise contact into a structure that can be reasoned about.
entry.summary: 从触觉表示、层级图结构和真机证据三个角度理解 TacGNN。

entry.title: 追鸟：一场跨越千年的迁徙发现
entry.content:
每年秋天，一些熟悉的鸟会突然从生活里消失。春天，它们又像没有发生过任何事一样回来。对古人来说，这个问题既简单又神秘：它们究竟去了哪里？

答案的寻找过程，几乎就是一部缩小版的人类认知史。人们先猜错，再争论，然后留下标记、等待证据，最终学会把一只鸟的飞行放到全球尺度上理解。

Every autumn, familiar birds disappear. In spring, they return as if nothing unusual had happened. For early observers, the question was both simple and mysterious: where do they go?

The search for an answer is a compact history of human understanding. People guessed, argued, marked individual birds, waited for evidence and eventually learned to see a single flight at a global scale.

1822一支非洲木矛，重新定义白鹳的旅程An African spear redefined a stork's journey
11,000 km斑尾塍鹬 E7 的连续飞行距离Continuous flight recorded by godwit E7
GPS把迁徙从传说变成可追踪的数据Turning migration from legend into traceable data

一开始，人类几乎全猜错了

亚里士多德曾认为，燕子可能会在岩石缝隙里冬眠。中世纪的一些观察者甚至猜测，小鸟会飞向月球。那时没有个体标记，也没有稳定的观察网络，消失与重现之间只能靠想象填补。

这类错误并不可笑。它提醒我们：当证据不足时，最自然的反应不是承认不知道，而是给出一个听起来完整的故事。

At first, almost everyone guessed wrong

Aristotle suggested that swallows might hibernate in rock crevices. Some medieval observers imagined that small birds flew to the moon. Without individual marks or a reliable observation network, imagination filled the gap between disappearance and return.

Those mistakes are not merely amusing. They show how readily people replace missing evidence with a story that sounds complete.

1822 年，一支木矛穿过天空

1822 年，德国猎人发现了一只返回春天的白鹳，它的身体里贯穿着一支来自非洲的木矛。这不是一则漂亮的寓言，而是一条可以被检查、测量、争论的物证。

从那一刻起，“鸟会跨越大陆”不再只是猜想。一个物体从远方穿越回来，把遥远的地理距离压缩成了一个可以直接观察的事实。

In 1822, an African spear returned with a stork

In 1822, a German hunter found a white stork returning in spring with an African spear embedded in its body. This was not a neat fable. It was physical evidence that could be inspected, measured and argued over.

From that point, migration was no longer only speculation. A foreign object had crossed continents and returned inside a living bird, compressing an enormous distance into something directly observable.

追踪技术，把猜测变成证据

真正可靠的研究需要回答更具体的问题：哪一只鸟，什么时候离开，经过了哪里，停留在哪里，又为什么选择这条路线？

  • 19 世纪末：科研人员开始给鸟腿戴上金属环，用重捕记录证明个体迁徙路线。
  • 20 世纪中期：雷达和无线电发射器让科学家第一次能连续观察运动轨迹。
  • 21 世纪：GPS、卫星和微型传感器把迁徙变成高分辨率的时间序列。

技术没有替人类提出问题，但它让问题变得可以被检验。

Tracking turned guesses into evidence

Reliable research required more specific questions: which bird left, when did it leave, where did it stop, and why did it choose that route?

  • Late 19th century: metal leg bands and recapture records revealed individual migration paths.
  • Mid 20th century: radar and radio transmitters made continuous movement observable.
  • 21st century: GPS, satellites and miniature sensors turned migration into high-resolution time-series data.

Technology did not replace human curiosity. It made curiosity testable.

E7：11,000 公里，没有停下来

2007 年，一只名为 E7 的斑尾塍鹬从阿拉斯加起飞。它没有中途进食，也没有落脚休息，连续飞行约 11,000 公里 后抵达新西兰。

这不是一次普通的“长途飞行”。它迫使研究者重新思考能量储备、天气窗口、身体极限和迁徙路线之间的关系。更重要的是，E7 的故事有了可以被复核的时间、地点和轨迹。

E7: 11,000 kilometres without stopping

In 2007, a bar-tailed godwit named E7 took off from Alaska. It did not feed or land along the way. After roughly 11,000 kilometres, it reached New Zealand.

This was not simply a very long flight. It forced researchers to rethink energy reserves, weather windows, physiological limits and route selection. More importantly, E7’s story came with time, place and a track that others could examine.

你也可以成为“观鸟侦探”

今天的迁徙研究不只属于大型实验室。普通观察者记录到的时间、地点和数量，也可以在长期尺度上成为重要数据。

  1. 在手机或电脑上注册 eBird。
  2. 记录一次真实观察：时间、地点、物种和数量。
  3. 保持稳定更新，哪怕每次只记录身边最常见的鸟。

科学并不总从宏大的设备开始。有时候，它从一个人愿意认真记录一只鸟开始。

You can be a bird detective too

Migration research no longer belongs only to large laboratories. Observations from ordinary people can become important data when they are consistent over time.

  1. Create an account on eBird.
  2. Record a real observation: date, place, species and count.
  3. Keep contributing, even if it is only the common bird outside your window.

Science does not always begin with a grand instrument. Sometimes it begins when one person decides to record one bird carefully.

从岩石缝隙到月球，从一支木矛到 11,000 公里的轨迹，人类对候鸟的理解，是一次不断修正错误、重新观察世界的过程。

From rock crevices to the moon, from an embedded spear to an 11,000-kilometre track, our understanding of migration is a record of correcting mistakes and learning to look again.

神话让故事开始，科学给它翅膀。 Myth starts the story. Science gives it wings.
entry.summary: 从神话、猎奇和误解，到候鸟追踪、卫星定位与全球公民科学。

entry.title: 从 Markdown 到 GitHub Pages：一套更简洁的发布流程
entry.content:
01Markdown专注内容Write
02Hexo生成页面Build
03GitHub Pages自动发布Publish

这套流程解决什么

目标很具体：平时只写 Markdown，运行一条命令，网站自动生成并发布到 GitHub Pages。域名、HTTPS 和后续内容更新都不需要每次重新配置。

这套方案适合愿意维护少量代码、希望文章仍然掌握在自己文件里的人。如果你完全不想接触终端，可以在最后了解本地内容输入工具，但底层流程仍然是下面这些步骤。

What this workflow solves

The goal is concrete: write Markdown, run one command, and publish the generated site to GitHub Pages. The domain, HTTPS and routine content updates should not require a new setup every time.

This approach is for people who are comfortable maintaining a small amount of code and want to keep their writing in local files. A content input tool can reduce the command-line work later, but the publishing pipeline remains the same.

1. 准备环境

Then install the Hexo CLI:

2. Create and preview the site

The default address is http://localhost:4000. Once it opens correctly, update the theme, navigation and page content. The main commands are:

Do not run multiple local servers at once. If the port is occupied, choose another one:

3. 建立 GitHub Pages 仓库

对于用户主页，仓库名必须遵循：

例如：Simon-zj1.github.io。创建仓库后，把 Hexo 的部署目标写入 _config.yml：

使用 SSH 地址比 HTTPS 更适合长期部署，但前提是这台电脑已经配置好 GitHub SSH Key。

3. Create the GitHub Pages repository

For a user site, the repository name must follow this pattern:

For example: Simon-zj1.github.io. After creating the repository, point Hexo at it in _config.yml:

SSH is convenient for long-term deployment, provided the machine already has a GitHub SSH key.

4. 把发布变成一条命令

项目里可以使用一个简单脚本，先清理、生成，再部署：

再把它加入 package.json：

之后每次更新只需要：

如果要进一步减少操作，可以再做一个本地内容输入界面，把自然语言整理成 Markdown，并在保存后调用同一个发布命令。重要的是：内容输入可以更方便，但最后仍然走同一条可重复的构建与部署流程。

4. Reduce publishing to one command

A small script can clean, build and deploy the site:

Add it to package.json:

Every update then becomes:

If you want less command-line work later, add a local content interface that turns natural language into Markdown and calls the same deploy command after saving. The input can be easier, but the build and publish path remains reproducible.

5. 配置自定义域名

在仓库的 Settings > Pages 中填写域名，例如 www.example.com。DNS 通常需要两条记录：

然后在 Hexo 的 source/CNAME 中写入同一个域名：

DNS 生效后，重新部署，并在 GitHub Pages 中等待证书签发。HTTPS 证书不是即时生成的，解析正确也不代表证书马上可用。

5. Connect a custom domain

Enter the domain in Settings > Pages, for example www.example.com. DNS normally needs two kinds of records:

Then place the same domain in source/CNAME:

After DNS resolves, redeploy and wait for the certificate in GitHub Pages. HTTPS is not issued instantly, and correct DNS alone does not guarantee an immediate certificate.

常见问题速查

Quick troubleshooting

现象Symptom 先检查什么Check first
本地页面打不开Local site does not open 端口是否占用、Hexo 是否仍在前台运行Port conflicts and whether Hexo is still running
部署提示 SSH 错误Deploy fails with SSH error 仓库地址、Deploy Key、Git 二进制路径Repository URL, deploy key and Git binary path
域名能访问但证书异常Domain opens but HTTPS fails DNS 记录、CNAME 文件、GitHub Pages 证书状态DNS records, CNAME file and certificate status
浏览器仍显示旧图标Browser still shows an old icon 固定标签页缓存，先取消固定再重新打开Pinned-tab cache; unpin the tab and open it again

好的发布流程不是让技术变得更复杂，而是让你不再为重复操作分心，把精力留给内容本身。

A good publishing workflow does not add complexity. It removes repeated work so attention can return to the writing.
entry.summary: 从环境安装、Hexo 配置、GitHub Pages 部署到自定义域名，一条可以复现的发布流程。
